# Agent Bits — Full Agent Documentation

Small, reliable utilities and datasets for AI agents.

## Identity

- Name: Agent Bits
- Website: https://agentbits.dev
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp
- API: https://agentbits.dev/api
- GitHub: https://github.com/rwaldman/agentbits
- Catalog version: 0.2.0
- Updated: 2026-08-12

## How to use

### MCP

Connect an MCP-compatible client to `https://agentbits.dev/mcp`.
Tool names and input schemas match the HTTP capability contracts.

### HTTP

JSON-first HTTP API under `https://agentbits.dev/api` and versioned paths under `/v1`.
See OpenAPI for the published machine-readable surface.

### Payments

Capabilities may be free or paid. Paid access uses payment protocol adapters
(initially x402 / mock test adapter). Agents should follow machine-readable payment challenges
returned by the service. See docs/payments.md.

## Errors

Errors are machine-readable JSON objects with stable codes:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_INPUT",
    "message": "Human-readable explanation.",
    "field": "optional_field_name"
  }
}
```

## Capabilities

### base64_decode

- Type: tool
- Description: Decode a Base64 string into UTF-8 text, reporting invalid payloads as errors.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic Base64 decoding.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/base64_decode.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/base64/decode
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / base64_decode

### base64_encode

- Type: tool
- Description: Encode a UTF-8 string into standard Base64.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic Base64 encoding of text.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/base64_encode.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/base64/encode
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / base64_encode

### countries

- Type: dataset
- Description: Versioned curated country metadata dataset used by country_lookup and countries_bulk.
- When to use: Use when an agent needs ISO country metadata as a dataset rather than invoking a single lookup.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/datasets/countries.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: paid 0.001 USDC/request via x402
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/datasets/countries/v1.json
- Limitations: Bulk download is paid. Single-country lookup via country_lookup remains free.

### countries_bulk

- Type: tool
- Description: Retrieve the full versioned countries dataset used by Agent Bits country lookups. Use when an agent needs bulk offline country metadata rather than a single country lookup.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need the complete countries dataset for a specific version (for caching, offline use, or multi-country analysis) instead of looking up one country code at a time.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/countries_bulk.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: paid 0.001 USDC/request via x402
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/datasets/countries/v1.json
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / countries_bulk
- Limitations: Paid capability. Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 / payment challenge. Returns the curated Agent Bits countries dataset, not a live feed.

### country_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Look up metadata for an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Use this when an agent needs a country's name, currency, language, calling code, region, or related standardized country metadata.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a country identified by an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example CA, US, JP), including common name, official name, region, currency, calling code, or languages.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/country_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/countries/{code}
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / country_lookup
- Limitations: Accepts ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes only in v1. Dataset is a curated subset/versioned snapshot, not a live geopolitical feed.

### currencies

- Type: dataset
- Description: Curated currencies dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
- When to use: Use when an agent needs the currencies reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/datasets/currencies.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- Limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service. Not a live continuously updating feed.

### currency_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Look up currency metadata for an ISO 4217 code, including name, symbol, decimals, and related countries.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a currency code such as USD, EUR, or JPY.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/currency_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/currencies/{code}
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / currency_lookup

### http_status_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Resolve a numeric HTTP status code to its standard name and a short description.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need the meaning of an HTTP status code such as 404 or 429.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/http_status_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/http-status/{code}
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / http_status_lookup

### isbn_validate

- Type: tool
- Description: Validate ISBN-10/ISBN-13 identifiers using checksum rules and return normalized digits.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to determine whether an ISBN is checksum-valid.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/isbn_validate.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/isbn/validate
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / isbn_validate

### json_validate

- Type: tool
- Description: Parse and validate a JSON string, returning whether it is valid and a normalized form when possible.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to verify that text is valid JSON before further processing.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/json_validate.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/json/validate
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / json_validate

### language_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Look up language name and native name for an ISO 639-1 code.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need metadata for a language code such as en, fr, or ja.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/language_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/languages/{code}
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / language_lookup

### languages

- Type: dataset
- Description: Curated languages dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
- When to use: Use when an agent needs the languages reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/datasets/languages.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- Limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service. Not a live continuously updating feed.

### luhn_validate

- Type: tool
- Description: Validate identifiers such as payment-card-like numbers using the Luhn algorithm.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to verify a number with a Luhn check digit.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/luhn_validate.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/luhn/validate
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / luhn_validate

### mime_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Resolve a file extension or MIME type to curated MIME metadata.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need the MIME type for a file extension such as webp, or metadata for a MIME type string.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/mime_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/mime/lookup
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / mime_lookup

### mime-types

- Type: dataset
- Description: Curated mime-types dataset (v1, 20 records) used by related lookup tools.
- When to use: Use when an agent needs the mime-types reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/datasets/mime-types.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- Limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service. Not a live continuously updating feed.

### timestamp_convert

- Type: tool
- Description: Convert Unix epoch seconds/milliseconds to ISO-8601, or ISO-8601 to Unix epoch values.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic conversion between Unix timestamps and ISO-8601 datetimes.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/timestamp_convert.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/timestamp/convert
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / timestamp_convert

### timezone_convert

- Type: tool
- Description: Convert an ISO-8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another, preserving the instant.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to convert a datetime between IANA timezones, including daylight-saving-time-aware conversions.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/timezone_convert.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/timezone/convert
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / timezone_convert
- Limitations: Relies on the runtime IANA timezone database via Intl.

### timezones

- Type: dataset
- Description: Curated timezones dataset (v1, 17 records) used by related lookup tools.
- When to use: Use when an agent needs the timezones reference dataset or related lookup metadata.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/datasets/timezones.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- Limitations: Bundled curated snapshot served by the hosted service. Not a live continuously updating feed.

### tld_lookup

- Type: tool
- Description: Look up curated metadata for a DNS top-level domain such as com, io, or ai.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to understand what a TLD is classified as or commonly used for.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/tld_lookup.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: GET https://agentbits.dev/v1/tlds/{tld}
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / tld_lookup

### unit_convert

- Type: tool
- Description: Convert numeric values between supported units for length, mass, and temperature.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic unit conversion such as miles to kilometers or Celsius to Fahrenheit.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/unit_convert.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/unit/convert
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / unit_convert
- Limitations: Supports a curated set of length, mass, and temperature units in v1.

### url_decode

- Type: tool
- Description: Decode a percent-encoded URL component into plain text.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic URL component decoding.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/url_decode.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/url/decode
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / url_decode

### url_encode

- Type: tool
- Description: Apply encodeURIComponent-style percent-encoding to a string.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need deterministic URL component encoding.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/url_encode.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/url/encode
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / url_encode

### uuid_validate

- Type: tool
- Description: Validate whether a string is a UUID and identify UUID version/variant metadata when possible.
- When to use: Use this tool when you need to check if a value is a valid UUID, including common version 4 identifiers.
- Documentation: https://agentbits.dev/tools/uuid_validate.md
- Version: 1
- Pricing: free
- HTTP: POST https://agentbits.dev/v1/uuid/validate
- MCP: https://agentbits.dev/mcp / uuid_validate

## Limitations

- The public repository contains documentation and discovery metadata only.
- The hosted implementation is proprietary.
- Unpublished/internal capabilities are intentionally omitted.
